local credits = game.CreditsData() game.read(credits) local paddingTop = {} local paddingBottom = {} for i=0,credits.header:size()-1 do paddingTop[credits.header[i].header] = credits.header[i].paddingTop paddingBottom[credits.header[i].header] = credits.header[i].paddingBottom end local previous = nil for i=0,credits.credit:size()-1 do
template = menu:addTemplateElement("template_credit", ("credit" .. i), element) if previous == nil then template:relativeTo(element:GetComponent("CreditsImage")) template:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(0,30*game.hudScale(), 0, lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.TOP)) template:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.BOTTOM) else template:relativeTo(previous) template:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(0, paddingBottom[credits.credit[i - 1].header] + paddingTop[credits.credit[i].header], 0, lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.TOP)) template:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.BOTTOM) end template["Text"]("text"):SetString(game.getLocalizedText(credits.credit[i].title))
previous = template template:init() template:setPositionBroadcast(true) if(credits.credit[i].header == "H1") then template["Text"]("font"):SetString(game.getTextFont()) template["Text"]("size"):SetFloat(0.4*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480)) template["Text"]("red"):SetFloat(0.15) template["Text"]("green"):SetFloat(0.69) template["Text"]("blue"):SetFloat(0.97) elseif(credits.credit[i].header == "H2") then template["Text"]("font"):SetString(game.getTextFont()) template["Text"]("size"):SetFloat(0.32*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480)) template["Text"]("red"):SetFloat(0.43) template["Text"]("green"):SetFloat(1.0) template["Text"]("blue"):SetFloat(0.25) else template["Text"]("font"):SetString(game.getTextFont()) template["Text"]("size"):SetFloat(0.28*(lua_sys.screenWidth()/480)) end end element("counter"):Set(0) element("numCredits"):Set(credits.credit:size()-1)

local transitionTime = element("transitionTime"):GetFloat()
local frame = element:GetElement("Frame")
frame("xOffset"):SetFloat(lua_sys.screenWidth()*(0.5) - (0.5)*lua_sys.screenWidth()*(1/transitionTime)) element["FadedBG"]["Sprite"]("alpha"):SetFloat(transitionTime*0.5)

if(dt < game.maxTickTime()) then
local transitionState = element("transitionState"):GetInt() local transitionTime = element("transitionTime"):GetFloat()
if(transitionState == 0) then
local firstCredit = element:GetComponent("CreditsImage") firstCredit("yOffset"):SetFloat(firstCredit("yOffset"):GetFloat() - (dt*35))
if(element:GetElement("credit"..(element("numCredits"):GetInt())):absY() < element:GetElement("Frame"):absY()) then game.popPopUp() end collectgarbage("step", 20) else
element:DoStoredScript("TickTransition")
if(transitionState == 1) then transitionTime = (transitionTime + dt*3) elseif(transitionState == 2) then transitionTime = (transitionTime - dt*3) end
element("transitionTime"):SetFloat(transitionTime)
if(transitionTime > 1.0) then element("transitionState"):SetInt(0) element("transitionTime"):SetFloat(1.0) element:DoStoredScript("TickTransition") elseif(transitionTime < 0.0) then element:root():popPopUp() manager:setContext("OPTIONS") end
end
